title: Florida Uniform Mitigation Verification Inspection Form (OIR-B1-1802)

form_revision.description: Form number and revision printed in the footer, e.g. OIR-B1-1802 (Rev. 04/26).

inspection_date.description: Inspection Date at the top of page 1, as YYYY-MM-DD.

zip.description: Zip code as written, including any +4 suffix.

insurance_company.description: Insurance Company, or null if blank.

year_of_home.description: Year of Home, from the Owner Information block.

number_of_stories.description: # of Stories, from the Owner Information block.

building_code.description: Question 1, Building Code: the letter of the checked answer (marked with an X). A = FBC 2001 & 2004, B = FBC 2007 and later, C = SFBC-94 (HVHZ only), D = unknown or does not meet A, B or C.

wind_region.description: Question 2, Region: the checked design-windspeed region.

roof_slope.description: Question 3, Roof Slope: the checked answer.

roof_coverings.description: Question 4.1: one entry for each roof covering type that is checked. Omit unchecked types.

covering_type.description: Checked roof covering type, e.g. Asphalt/Fiberglass Shingle, Concrete/Clay Tile, Metal.

permit_application_date.description: Permit Application Date for this covering, as YYYY-MM-DD, or null if blank.

product_approval_number.description: FBC or MDC Product Approval #, or null if blank.

year_installed.description: Year of Original Installation or Replacement, or null if blank.

no_information_provided.description: True if the 'No Information Provided for Compliance' box is checked for this covering.

product_approval_listing.description: Question 4.2, Product Approval Listing: the letter of the checked answer.

roof_deck_attachment.description: Question 5, Roof Deck Attachment: the letter of the checked answer (the weakest form of roof deck attachment).

answer.description: Letter of the checked answer: A Toenails, B Clips, C Single Wraps, D Double Wraps, E Structural, F Other, G Unknown, H No attic access, I Not installed as intended.

minimal_condition.description: Which numbered minimal condition (1, 2 or 3) is checked, or null if none.

answer.description: Letter of the checked answer: A Hip Roof, B Flat Roof, C Other Roof.

non_hip_feature_length_ft.description: Total length of non-hip features in feet, or null if blank.

total_roof_perimeter_ft.description: Total roof system perimeter in feet, or null if blank.

secondary_water_resistance.description: Question 8, Sealed Roof Deck / Secondary Water Resistance (SWR).

answer.description: Letter of the checked answer: A Sealed Roof Deck, B No Sealed Roof Deck, C Unknown.

swr_method.description: For answer A, the checked SWR method (e.g. fully adhered polymer-modified bitumen underlayment), or null.

answer.description: Letter of the checked main answer: the weakest form of wind-borne debris protection.

sub_answer.description: Checked sub-answer for non-glazed openings, e.g. A.1, B.2, N.3, or null if none.

chart.description: Opening Protection Level Chart: for each opening type (column), the row level (N/A, A, B, C, D, N, X or Z) marked with an X.

glazed_windows_or_entry_doors.description: Level marked for glazed windows or entry doors.

glazed_garage_doors.description: Level marked for glazed garage doors.

non_glazed_entry_doors.description: Level marked for non-glazed entry doors.

non_glazed_garage_doors.description: Level marked for non-glazed garage doors.

qualification.description: The checked 'I hold an active license as a' option, e.g. Home inspector licensed under Section 468.8314, Florida Statutes.

signed.description: True if the Qualified Inspector Signature line is signed.

signature_date.description: Date beside the inspector signature, as YYYY-MM-DD.

homeowner_signed.description: True if the homeowner certification Signature line is signed.
